explication: Build with Claude is a discovery and installation marketplace for Claude Code extensions. Users browse or search plugins, skills, agents, commands, hooks, MCP servers, and marketplaces; inspect detail pages; then copy install commands or download artifacts. Community and local content is indexed into the database and Meilisearch by scheduled/admin workflows. The sampled excerpts confirm UI rendering, search client behavior, detail-page packaging, database-backed marketplace queries, and migration logic; some list-page and indexer wiring is inferred only from explicit paths and README capabilities.
